dict.string: Your location is used to find matches within the distance you choose. Only an approximate location is stored and your exact coordinates are never shown on your profile.
Choose photos from your library to use on your profile.
Use the front camera to compare a live face scan with your chosen profile photo. The scan is processed on this device and is not saved or uploaded.
Stop Swiping uses your local network to find the phone you hold yours against, so the two of you can exchange profiles directly.
Stop Swiping measures the distance to another phone, so profiles are only exchanged when you hold your phones together.
